summary: GridSense AI: 23/23 backend pytest pass; FE customer + admin portals load and navigate correctly. Landing, customer login (demo@gridsense.in/demo@123), dashboard with stat cards/recommended window/sessions, planner, stations (Leaflet), profile, logout, admin login (EMP001/bescom@123), Live Grid Overview, Forecast, Schedules, Zone Map, Events, Customers, Reports all reachable without errors.

minor.issue: allow_origins=["*"] with allow_credentials=True violates CORS spec; browsers ignore credentials. Cookies still sent because frontend uses Bearer fallback, but should set explicit origin.
secure=False and samesite=lax — works because Bearer fallback is used; cross-site cookie won't persist in production HTTPS. Use secure=True, samesite=none for cross-origin.

issues: Recharts width(-1) height(-1) warnings on initial render — charts still display but parent container momentarily has 0 size

action_items: Optional: tighten CORS to explicit REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL origin and set cookie secure=True, samesite=none for production
Optional: set Recharts container minWidth/minHeight or aspect to silence chart-size warnings
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_credentials=True with origins=['*'] is invalid per spec
Cookie samesite=lax + secure=False won't survive cross-site over HTTPS; FE relies on localStorage Bearer which works
get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header — fine but means stale cookies override Bearer (showed up in tests)
JWT_SECRET pulled from env (good); no refresh token; 1-day access acceptable for demo
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on login endpoints (auth playbook recommends 5-fail lockout)
test_credentials: admin EMP001/bescom@123, customer demo@gridsense.in/demo@123 — both verified
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 8 zones, ~40 stations, 24h forecasts/zone, 28 events, 20 schedules, demo+11 customers, 3 admins on startup — verified counts via API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_gridsense_api.py covers all endpoints. Use BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Cookie precedence in get_current_user causes shared sessions to leak — use fresh requests for cross-role tests.
